name: Liburnicon
blurb: A summer SF and fantasy festival in Opatija (at Ika) with cosplay, tabletop games, panels and workshops.

last.venue: Fakultet za menadžment u turizmu i ugostiteljstvu (FMTU), Ika

notes: Homepage text: 'LIBURNICON 21. – 22. kolovoza 2026. FMTU, Ika, Opatija OUTLAWED EDITION' plus a press mention 'ugostio 21. Liburnicon' (hosted the 21st Liburnicon) confirm this was the 21st edition and that it already ended before today; no 2027 dates are posted, so editions is empty and this run is recorded as 'last'. This is clearly active, not the 'uncertain status' the discovery batch flagged — the site names a specific numbered 2026 edition, a named theme, a post-event media writeup and photo galleries from the days of the event. Types expanded from the batch's scifi-only to add cosplay (nav has a dedicated cosplay-competition page) and tabletop (homepage lists a 'BOARDGAME ZONA' and 'IGRE I TURNIRI'/games & tournaments). Organizer and contact from the footer: 'Udruga "Kulturni front"', liburnicon@kulturnifront.hr. Cover uses logo:1 (the festival's own gold logo at full size, 800x800); the hero images are all crowd/event photos from past editions, which RESEARCH.md says to avoid.
